## The Golden Record: Earth’s Sounds and Instructions for Playing Them

Each Voyager spacecraft carried a gold-plated record containing selected material from Earth, along with guidance for playing it.

The collection included 115 analog images, natural sounds, music from different cultures and eras, and spoken greetings in 55 languages. Each record came with a cartridge and needle, plus symbolic instructions explaining the spacecraft’s origin and how to play the audio.

The Golden Record thus combined a collection of material from Earth with information for playing it.
